archetypes.name: parity-contract
archetypes.rationale: The port replaces Bash leaf helpers with Python and must preserve exact contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Python review_dispatch port against the retired shell helper contracts. Focus on exit codes, stdout and FD-3 grammars, argument validation ordering, timeout math, and redaction/tail bounds. Call out any subtle parity drift that targeted tests may miss Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: caller-cutover
archetypes.rationale: Multiple review and design shell callers now cross the Python CLI boundary.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review caller retargeting for argv safety and harness compatibility. Focus on collect-agent-results, dispatch-code-voters, collect-findings, gather-context, dispatch-panel, and plan-review-loop. Verify legacy diagnostic wording is preserved only where intentionally asserted Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
